title: MASDP Project Registry (projects.json)
description: ASPS-770 — frozen project-config contract for ADR-006 (MASDP/SPS separation). One record per managed project. MASDP is tenant #0 and MUST appear as a record in its own registry (dogfooding, ADR-006 'Project-config contract'). Authored in the SPS repo now; the canonical copy moves into the MASDP repo in ASPS-771/772 — do not treat this copy as living documentation once that migration lands.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this file's shape. Bump on any breaking change to the record shape below.

projects.description: Every project MASDP manages, including MASDP itself (tenant #0). Order is not significant.

projectRecord.title: Project record
projectRecord.description: { name, github_repo, jira_project, working_dir, domain_context, secrets_ref } — the six fields locked by ADR-006 decision 1. No other fields are permitted by this schema version; extend via schema_version bump, not silent addition.

name.description: Stable project slug. Lowercase kebab-case. Used as the human/agent-facing project identifier (e.g. the Telegram bot's project-selector key, the Knowledge Engine collection suffix per ADR-006 decision 4). Must be unique across the registry.

github_repo.description: The project's GitHub repository, as 'owner/repo' or a full https://github.com/owner/repo(.git) URL. Does not include credentials — the repo is public-shape metadata; auth for cloning/pushing is resolved via secrets_ref.

jira_project.description: The JIRA project key this project's issues live under (Atlassian project-key shape: 2-10 chars, uppercase letters/digits, starting with a letter).

working_dir.description: Where the project's clone lives on the MASDP host. Either an absolute path (POSIX '/...' or Windows 'C:\...' / 'C:/...') or a path relative to a configured projects root, written with a leading './' so relative-vs-absolute is unambiguous by inspection alone.

domain_context.description: Path to the project's own entry-point instructions (its CLAUDE.md / role-pack root under its working_dir) — the project's 'what' that MASDP's generic 'how' loads per project. Same path-shape rules as working_dir: absolute, or relative with a leading './' (commonly relative to the project's own working_dir, e.g. './CLAUDE.md').

secrets_ref.description: Opaque handle naming this project's secret bundle. Resolved by MASDP's secrets loader to a directory OUTSIDE every project clone on the host — see docs/architecture/contracts/SECRETS-REF-BUNDLE-LAYOUT.md. This field is a NAME, never a path and never a value — the bundle's on-disk location is a host-level convention (bundle root + secrets_ref), not something this file encodes directly, so this JSON can be safely reviewed/diffed without exposing host filesystem layout.
